facts.title: Houses the Oldest Desert
facts.description: The Namib is the world's oldest desert — and the only desert where large mammals like elephants, rhinos, lions, and giraffes survive.

facts.title: Highest Sand Dunes
facts.description: Sossusvlei's dunes are among the tallest on Earth — Big Daddy rises over 325 metres above the ancient clay pan of Deadvlei.

facts.title: Second Largest Canyon
facts.description: Fish River Canyon in southern Namibia is Africa's largest canyon — a vast landscape carved by the oldest river in the region.

facts.title: Largest Inland Delta
facts.description: Botswana's Okavango Delta is the world's largest inland delta — 22,000 km² of floodplains teeming with wildlife.

facts.title: Smoke That Thunders
facts.description: Victoria Falls creates a mist column visible from 50 km away. Locals call it Mosi-oa-Tunya — "The Smoke That Thunders."

facts.title: Kingdom in the Sky
facts.description: Lesotho is the only country entirely above 1,000 metres — earning its title as the "Kingdom in the Sky."

topDestinations.name: Etosha National Park
topDestinations.desc: One of Africa's greatest and oldest game parks — legendary waterhole viewing around a vast salt pan.

topDestinations.name: Sossusvlei & Namib-Naukluft
topDestinations.desc: Iconic red dunes in one of the world's largest conservation areas — the oldest desert on Earth.

topDestinations.name: Fish River Canyon
topDestinations.desc: Africa's largest canyon — dramatic multi-day hiking and panoramic desert vistas.

topDestinations.name: Swakopmund & Walvis Bay
topDestinations.desc: Coastal adventure hub — German colonial charm, dunes, skydiving, and fresh Atlantic oysters.

topDestinations.name: Damaraland & Kaokoland
topDestinations.desc: Desert-adapted elephants, rhino tracking, Twyfelfontein rock art, and Himba culture.

topDestinations.name: Kavango & Zambezi
topDestinations.desc: Lush riverine wilderness — a tropical contrast to the Namib with hippos, crocs, and mokoro trips.

topDestinations.name: Victoria Falls
topDestinations.desc: One of the Seven Natural Wonders — thundering cascades on the Zambia–Zimbabwe border.

topDestinations.name: Okavango Delta
topDestinations.desc: UNESCO wetland wilderness — mokoro safaris through papyrus channels teeming with wildlife.

topDestinations.name: Kruger National Park
topDestinations.desc: Africa's flagship self-drive safari — Big Five, 500+ birds, and 2 million hectares of bushveld.

travelNews.title: KAZA UniVisa extended at Victoria Falls crossings
travelNews.excerpt: The $50 UniVisa continues to cover multiple entries between Zambia and Zimbabwe, including day trips to Botswana's Chobe National Park via Kazungula.

travelNews.title: Namibia visa rules updated from 1 April 2025
travelNews.excerpt: Many nationals (including UK, US, EU, and Australia) now need an e-visa or visa-on-arrival. SADC visitors are often still exempt — confirm on mha.gov.na before travel.

travelNews.title: Gorongosa reports record predator sightings
travelNews.excerpt: Mozambique's restored wilderness continues its remarkable recovery — lion and elephant populations reach new highs.

travelNews.title: Kazungula Bridge cuts Chobe crossing times
travelNews.excerpt: The modern bridge linking Botswana, Zambia, and Zimbabwe has replaced the slow pontoon — plan Victoria Falls circuit day trips with confidence.

travelNews.title: Herero Living Museum opens in Otjokavare
travelNews.excerpt: A new cultural experience in northwest Namibia offers immersive insight into Herero traditions, dress, and daily life.

travelNews.title: Self-drive season peaks across Southern Africa
travelNews.excerpt: Dry-season wildlife viewing (May–October) is underway — book park accommodation and 4x4 rentals early for peak months.
